visual-ops-writer 1.0.1

- 新增两张素材图片：assets/02.jpg、assets/03.jpg
- 其它功能、文档未变

Initial release of visual-ops-writer.

- Provides end-to-end creation of operational articles: topic selection, writing, illustration, and quality inspection.
- Supports three main scenarios: link imitation, Skill promotion articles, and automatic illustration for existing content.
- Built-in quality control system with nine article checks and automatic illustration matching article structure.
- Flexible style, tone, reader persona, and illustration options; handles both text-only and illustrated outputs.
- Simple setup process supporting both key-based illustration and pure text output.
